payload.objective: Write the required durable, self-contained Sol handoff at reports/sol-handoff/README.md.
scope: May add or edit reports/sol-handoff/README.md only for the handoff, using completed work and evidence under reports/councilflow-finalization/ and reports/gate3-next/.
Do not edit product sources, existing historical reports, frozen governance, existing hardening evidence, global settings, unrelated projects, or Git history.
instructions: Include exact canonical repo path, baseline HEAD, final branch/local commit or uncommitted diff state, source ZIP SHA-256 and byte-equivalence scope.

Summarize completed work and changed files; link retirement-audit.json and state active/package scan results and immutable historical exceptions/hashes without making the retired component sound like an active option.

Record exact six-suite commands, counts, skips/failures after Tester evidence is available; package SHA-256, entry count, source-byte map, extracted results, and independent Reviewer rerun evidence. Do not claim prior hardening evidence was newly rerun.

Separate verified/unverified OS security, Codebase Memory stale/unavailable fallback, and native host observations. State the local CLI version and disclose exact model/config NOT_DISCLOSED if unavailable.
State Gate 3 E1-E10 NOT EXECUTED in this mission, readiness verdict, missing authentic Owner fixture and host capabilities, and link OWNER-TASK-DRAFT.txt plus the single-instruction template.
Add a compact findings table with severity, proof, acceptance check, disposition; prioritize the actual remaining limitations and explain the final COMPLETE/PARTIAL outcome.
State no remote push/merge happened, the historic failures remain intact, no standalone recall capability was reintroduced, and never claim COUNCILFLOW_FULLY_VERIFIED.
If Tester/Reviewer/Planner final evidence is not yet available, leave explicit placeholders and update only after receiving evidence. Stop edits after the final report is complete.
